title: fleet-write: a relay stroke of up to 20 content-creating writes runs at the 3 s gap — write-pace rule ⑤ (batch gap 30 s) never applies on the relay path, so one stroke is a burst
body:
Filing gate: **① a violation of a declared contract, with a measured reproduction** (`pm:queue` class, tooling).
Reader: the `domain:skills` seat owning `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` (`dispatch.mjs`, `execute.mjs`) — the fix PR there.
Dedupe (open AND closed, semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectstack): "fleet-write relay executor batch mode announce-batch write-pace rule five runner pace log not shared" → 6 hits, none on point (nearest #19572, closed — it introduced `write-pace.mjs`); "relay stroke many issue_create actions burst 3 second gap secondary rate limit" → 0.

reach: measured — relay run https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39369675259 executed one stroke of 15 `issue_create` actions against objectstack-ai/objectui; the issues landed 3 s apart, 15 issues in 42 s (objectstack-ai/objectui#13122 at 04:27:43Z … objectstack-ai/objectui#13137 at 04:28:25Z, 2026-10-20). A second stroke the same day from another cloud session landed 16 issues the same way.
type: Bug

Filed by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi` on the maintainer's instruction there (approving the proposal to file this card, verbatim: 「同意」). The bursts above were this session's own strokes: it called `dispatch.mjs` directly with a batch, which `references/rest-channel.md` already says is for landing only ("批量恒走逐 op 工具,直调 `dispatch.mjs` 仅落地"). This card is about the tool letting that through silently.

## What is declared

- `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs` rule ⑤: a caller about to create or change N ≥ 5 objects announces the batch first, and the gap for the next N writes rises to 30 s — the maintainer's ruling 「截流应该要加」 made mechanical, after two seat accounts were suspended for bursts of content creation.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` header: "Every write goes through `write-pace.mjs` like every other fleet write", with the runner's own home holding the log and "the twenty-action cap" bounding the run.

## What happens

- `dispatch.mjs` accepts a stroke of up to 20 content-creating actions (`MAX_ACTIONS`) with no batch announcement and no refusal, even when the stroke is not a landing.
- The executor on the runner paces each write with rule ① only (3 s): its pace log is fresh per run, no announcement reaches it from the seat container, so rule ⑤ never applies on the relay path. A 15-action stroke is a 42-second burst from one identity — the rate shape the throttle exists to prevent.
- Across containers nothing is shared at all (the throttle's own header says so), so several cloud sessions each sending a stroke multiply the burst.

## Expected fix shape

Either (A) the executor applies the batch gap itself when one stroke carries ≥ `DEFAULT_BATCH_THRESHOLD` content-creating writes (it holds the whole stroke, so it can announce on the runner before the first write), or (B) `dispatch.mjs` refuses a non-landing stroke over the threshold and names the per-op tools (`issue-create.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`) that already pace batches. (A) closes the burst for every caller; (B) alone keeps the burst possible for anyone who splits strokes. A pin: a stroke of five `issue_create` actions on a stubbed platform shows ≥ 30 s between writes (injected clock), or a refusal with the prescription.
